abort.reauth_successful: The new local key works. The air purifier is connected again.

error.no_devices_found: No Birdie devices were discovered. You can still add one manually by entering its Bluetooth address.
error.invalid_device_id: Enter the device ID exactly as shown in the Birdie app. Long-press it in the app to copy it.

error.device_not_found: The air purifier was not found on your network. Make sure it is switched on and connected to the same network as Home Assistant, or enter its IP address.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the air purifier. Make sure it is switched on, connected to Wi-Fi and on a network Home Assistant can reach, then try again.
error.invalid_local_key: The air purifier did not accept this local key. The key changes every time the purifier is added again in the Birdie app, so copy the current one. Close other apps that control the purifier on your local network (such as Homey) and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

purifier_pick.title: Add Birdie Podium
purifier_pick.description: These Birdie Podium air purifiers were found on your network. If you have more than one, compare the device ID with the one shown in the Birdie app.

purifier_key.title: Connect your Birdie Podium
purifier_key.description:
Home Assistant needs the local key of this Podium to control it on your network.

1. In the Birdie app, find the device ID and local key of this Podium.
2. Long-press the local key to copy it.
3. Paste it below.

This Podium: device ID `{device_id}`, IP address {host}.

Tip: open Home Assistant on the same phone to paste it straight away.

data_description.local_key: 16 characters, exactly as shown in the Birdie app. It changes whenever the Podium is added again in the app.

purifier_manual.title: Add Birdie Podium
purifier_manual.description: Long-press the device ID and the local key in the Birdie app to copy them, and paste them here. Leave the IP address empty and Home Assistant will search your network for the Podium.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your Podium
reauth_confirm.description:
{name} no longer accepts its local key. This happens when the Podium is added again in the Birdie app, which gives it a new key.

In the Birdie app, long-press the local key of this Podium (device ID `{device_id}`) to copy it, and paste it below.
